info.name: Valence — your Atlas acceptance checks
info.description: Import alongside the blank Valence environment. Run core folders 01-06 against YOUR Atlas via Express. Optional folders 07-09 require your own Stripe/Cloudinary/email setup. No service credentials are shipped.

item.name: 01 — Public catalog and health
item.description: Read-only checks. baseUrl includes /api; frontendOrigin must match the server.

item.name: 02 — Buyer registration and login
item.description: Set buyerEmail and buyerPassword privately. Use a new test buyer in YOUR Atlas. Registration creates records; reruns should skip registration or use a new email. Tokens are saved only to your selected environment.

item.name: Refresh buyer — cookie jar handles rotation
03 — Cart and addresses
item.description: Mutates your buyer records. Requires an in-stock packaging option. Unapproved products can enter cart but cannot be purchased.

body.raw:
{
  "label": "Test delivery",
  "name": "Postman Buyer",
  "companyName": "User acceptance testing",
  "line1": "123 Test Street",
  "line2": "",
  "city": "Chennai",
  "state": "Tamil Nadu",
  "postalCode": "600001",
  "country": "India",
  "phone": "9000000000"
}

item.name: 04 — Public submissions and buyer RFQ
item.description: Run before staff checks. Guests can submit RFQs without accounts; attachments require login. These records should appear in staff queues after admin login.

body.raw:

item.name: 05 — Staff login, visibility and quote
item.description: Use YOUR seeded admin email/password. Login replaces the refresh cookie in the shared cookie jar. Run buyer cookie tests before this group; bearer buyerToken remains distinct.

item.name: All RFQs include the guest submission
06 — Quote acceptance
item.description: Run after the staff quote. Uses buyerToken, not the admin cookie. Converts the quote into an unpaid order; repeat acceptance should return the same order.

item.name: Log back in as buyer before logout check
07 — OPTIONAL Stripe checkout and fulfillment
item.description: Run individually only after YOU connect Stripe TEST mode and approve the catalog. Do not run blindly as part of the entire collection. Complete checkout in a browser and wait for the signed Stripe webhook before fulfillment. Prices here are test-only; no service is simulated.

body.raw:
{
  "shippingAddress": {
    "label": "Test delivery",
    "name": "Postman Buyer",

  "idempotencyKey": "{{$guid}}",
  "orderId": "{{orderId}}"
}

item.name: 08 — OPTIONAL files
item.description: Requires your Cloudinary credentials. Select your own PDF in the file field. Requests upload actual bytes to your account.

item.name: 09 — OPTIONAL password reset and logout
item.description: Requires YOUR working email provider to obtain a real resetToken. No reset token is returned in production. Set newPassword privately. This group revokes sessions. Run one request at a time.
